title: Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn
alloyReason: Triaxially forged Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn (UNS R56400) is specified for this ultrasonic tooling component where isotropic mechanical properties are mandatory for withstanding multi-axial stress states. The 3D forging process eliminates crystallographic texture directionality, delivering uniform 950 MPa tensile strength and >15% elongation in all three orientations. This is critical for Rectangular slot-patterned textile welding horn where fatigue crack initiation is sensitive to microstructural anisotropy. This rationale is driven by rectangular slot-patterned textile welding horn and service environment demands.
process: CNC turn-mill multi-axis for ultrasonic tooling geometry
Shot peening Almen with 0.5mm corner radius
Black oxide/DLC coating with 0.5mm corner radius
CMM SPC dimensional check with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for rectangular slotpatterned textile application
commonFailures: Brinelling of Al housing from steel insert - resolved by steel-backed bronze bushing SAE 841 0.05mm interfer — critical for rectangular slotpatterned textile performance

faq.q: What weight-to-strength ratio does Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn offer over steel?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V provides 40-45% weight reduction versus 4130/4340 steel at equivalent strength: 4.43 g/cm³ vs 7.85 g/cm³ with 830 MPa yield. For rectangular slotpatterned textile, this translates directly to reduced unsprung mass (suspension) or reduced reciprocating mass (valvetrain), improving both acceleration response and fatigue-limited component life by 2-3×.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn?
faq.a: Each Titanium Ultrasonic Slot-Patterned Horn shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for rectangular slotpatterned textile.
